verifications.check_code:
opts=['Neighbouring', 'Accommodating', 'Close', 'Distant']
ant={'Tame':'Wild','Adjacent':'Distant'}
r=ant['Adjacent']
assert r==opts[3]
assert all(r!=o for o in opts[:3])
steps: Neighbouring, Close are synonyms; Accommodating unrelated
P + Q: P is husband of Q, so Q is female
Q x R: R is sister of Q
R - S: S is mother of R (and Q)
S / T: S is daughter of T
Q is daughter of S, S daughter of T: Q is T's daughter's daughter

verifications.check_code:
opts=['Sister', 'Daughter’s daughter', 'Mother’s mother', 'Daughter’s husband']
# chain from T: T -> S is daughter; S -> Q is daughter (R,Q sisters, S mother)
chain=['daughter','daughter']
r=chain[0]+'’s '+chain[1]
r=r[0].upper()+r[1:]
assert r==opts[1]
assert all(r!=o for o in (opts[0],opts[2],opts[3]))
steps: P+Q: P husband of Q; Q x R: R sister of Q; R - S: S mother of R; S / T: S daughter of T
So Q is daughter of S, S is daughter of T
